artifact.fittedOn: DEV only, exact-normalized sequence SHA256 modulo20=1; TEST modulo20=0 was not read by calibration.
artifact.objective: Minimum mean conditional-next-letter negative log likelihood in nats across equal-size initial/body x prefix0/1/2 strata.
artifact.limitations: Same-corpus calibration; external wordfreq training may overlap. Temperature only calibrates letters conditional on continuing the current token, not end-of-word or word suggestions.

baselineCaveat: Historical baseline trained on DEV. This comparison is optimistic for the baseline and descriptive only; it did not affect the grid-search objective.
